sloka: ततस्तु ते तस्य वधेन भूरिणा मनस्विनो नैर्ऋतराजबान्धवाः।विनेदुरुच्चैर्व्यथिता रघूत्तमं हरिं समीक्ष्यैव यथा सुरार्दिताः ।। ६.६७.१६४ ।।
transliteration: tatastu te tasya vadhena bhūriṇā manasvino nairṛtarājabāndhavāḥ।vineduruccairvyathitā raghūttamaṁ hariṁ samīkṣyaiva yathā surārditāḥ ।। 6.67.164 ।।

translations.english: Perceiving Kumbhakarna with broken arms rushing towards him, Rama at once took a sharp moon shaped arrow and split his feet.
